videos.script: Two customers want the last copy of Frankenstein. They press the button in the same second. {{race}} Without care, both orders go through, and the shop has sold a book it does not have. Nothing fails. Nothing is logged. {{silent}} This lesson is about what stands between that second and a correct answer. {{three}} First, a transaction, so that an order happens completely or not at all. You watch one roll back. {{rollback}} Then the proxy Spring puts around your service, and the one kind of call that slips past it. {{proxy}} Then a lock, so that two transactions cannot both take the same copy. You produce the lost update first, and then you fix it. {{lock}} And last, the connection pool every transaction borrows from. You run it dry on purpose, and read what that looks like. {{pool}}
